sentences.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
sentences.zh: 有时曲棍球运动员变得如此好竞争以至于会爆发打架。

sentences.en: Our competitive position is weakened by the rising labor cost.
sentences.zh: 由于劳动力成本上升，我们的价格竞争力被削弱了。

sentences.en: Kendo has competitive matches, but in Iaido there are none.
sentences.zh: 剑道有比赛，但在居合道中则没有。

senses.zh: 竞争的，比赛的；有竞争力的，能竞争的；competitive销售的，价格等有竞争力的
